title: Non-Archimedean Bedford–Taylor theory
summary: A systematic programme for intrinsic differential operations, positive currents and pluripotential theory on Berkovich spaces.

title: Non-Archimedean geometry foundations
summary: An evolving reference connecting non-Archimedean analysis, formal geometry and tropical methods, with explicit proofs and stable references.

title: Beilinson–Bloch Heights and the Strong Zero-Curvature Green Conjecture
summary: A research programme towards an unconditional Beilinson–Bloch height pairing in arbitrary dimension, centred on the Strong Green conjecture and its conditional local-to-global height theorem.
